entries.land_description: 100 acres of woods, swamp, cranberry bog & gardens on the shore of Silver Lake, in the rapidly suburbanizing South Shore area of Massachusetts. We have camping facilities/open space/ farmwork experience to women and children.
entries.notes: My partner & I are the only residents of Feathers Farm, We are currently working to organize support and resources for a land trust to control this property. We have found lesbian separatism to be unworkable and alienating approach to this endeavor and expect unconditional acceptance of this from our visitors (whom we welcome AND encourage). We request that visitors bring their own food & donate $4/night camping fee, flexible. We often work out other arrangements for longer term apprenticeships or short term large groups. It is helpful if visits are preceeded by at least a phone-call, preferably a letter.

entries.land_description: 113 acres of Maine mountains/woodland. Parcels available for sale and/or building. Also plenty of space for camping, hiking, raspberry picking.
entries.welcomed_groups: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women, lesbians interested in buying land
entries.notes: Will answer all letters promptly. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 113 acres, housing/permanent structures, camping space, woods, women working and living on the land.

entries.land_description: 20 acres, creek, woods, open. 2 dyke-built dwellings, one large, one small. No plumbing or electricity.
entries.notes: None of the dyke collective owners live there now. It's rented to hets. Interested in dyke renters. 15 miles from town with jobs. Write before visiting.

entries.land_description: At present we are a working homestead farm. We offer year round space to women needing retreat or temporary living situation. We have gorgeous secluded land and campsites. Hope to build visitor cabins this summer. We have an all lesbian maple sugar bush
entries.welcomed_groups: community members, women wanting to build a cabin or tipi
entries.notes: Women from the Boston area visit almost every weekend. Right now we are offering x-country ski weekends — $35 plus meals is the fee. In summer we offer work exchange. We have an all lesbian maple sugar bush — the only one I know of. We work with a draft horse, raise dairy goats and chickens. We vegetarians raising nearly all our food organically here.
